newsitem.title: GREECE: COMMERCIAL BANK JOINS DIAS NETWORK OF ATMS.
newsitem.headline: COMMERCIAL BANK JOINS DIAS NETWORK OF ATMS.

text.p: Commercial Bank will join the DIAS interbank network of ATMs with its Telebank network, it said in a statement.
"Starting June 24, 1997 Commercial Bank joins its 382 ATMs to the interbank network," Commercial said.

Following the hook-up of Telebank ATMs to DIAS, holders of Commercial's cashpoint/credit cards Emporokarta, Emporokarta Visa and Telebank will be able to use other banks' cash points throughout Greece, withdrawing up to a maximum of 200,000 drachmas in cash. --Angelos Kiosklis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
